name: Ditto Biosciences
description: Evolutionary intelligence for autoimmune disease

founders.name: Dennis Sun
founders.bio: Scientist and operator transforming natural proteins into therapies. Trained in evolutionary and developmental biology at Harvard (AB) and UC Berkeley (PhD). Previously led software teams, product development, and scientific partnerships as Chief of Staff at a $500M biotech. Now building a platform to mine proteins from viruses, ticks, and worms that will become the next blockbuster drugs for autoimmune disease.

founders.name: Adair Borges
founders.bio: Entrepreneurial scientist using evolution to build the next generation of therapeutics for autoimmune disease. UCSF-trained PhD with expertise spanning parasitology, virology, and genomics. Published over 50 scientific papers, and is a coinventor on a patent for anti-CRISPR proteins. Former Miller Fellow at UC Berkeley, and previously led a venture creation team at an early stage biotech company. Motivated by a lifelong fascination with parasites.

founders.name: Emily Weiss
founders.bio: I'm a molecular and computational biologist working to revolutionize drug discovery for autoimmune disease. At Ditto, I lead the platform for engineering parasite-derived therapeutics. I hold a PhD in microbiology, genomics, and plant genetics, with a focus on sequencing, high-throughput screening, and computational pipeline development. Published in Nature Microbiology and eLife. Previously at Illumina, DuPont, and an early-stage biotech venture team.

founders.name: Nisha Gopal

Select Awards: UCLA MD-PhD Merit Scholar, UCLA TDG Senior Fellow, MIT iGEM Gold Medal, MIT IDEAs winner, MIT Dean Advisory Group, WhiteHouse Science Fair, Bessie Lawrence Scholar, Intel STS Finalist

founders.bio: Founder at Gamgee Technologies (YC S26), building personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs. Gamgee grew out of my work using AI and genomics to help my dog Rosie fight cancer. Previously co-founded Core Intelligence, building applied AI systems across startups and enterprise, and helped grow Australia’s AI community as a founding member of the Data Science & AI association of Australia. Background in ML, data science and electrical and computer systems engineering

founders.name: Sebastian Apelgren
founders.bio: Co-founder & CEO at Ordo Labs. Former lead quantitative researcher at Handelsbanken, one of the largest Nordic banks. Studied Engineering Mathematics at KTH Royal Institute of Technology and quantitative finance at the National University of Singapore.

founders.name: Kristina Hoang
founders.bio: Co-founder & CPO at Ordo Labs. Previously co-founded SecureTag, a pharma authentication platform developed with experts from AstraZeneca, Novo Nordisk and Bayer, and piloted with Uganda’s National Drug Authority. She has spent years building software for regulated pharma workflows. MS in Industrial Engineering & Management and MS in Machine Learning from KTH.

founders.name: Adam Tovatt
founders.bio: Co-founder & CTO at Ordo Labs. Co-founded Sakur, a software consultancy serving YC companies and European fintechs. Previously lead backend engineer at Careless, an AI-first UK insurance broker. Backend engineer at Redeye as well as Tradera, the largest Nordic secondhand marketplace. Has shipped production systems across insurance, lending and debt management.
